Flat collection of independent Node.js scripts under `scripts/`, each a self-contained CLI entry point invoked via `node scripts/<name>.js`. Shared utilities are factored into two modules: `git-utils.js` (exports `getRepos`, `parseGitModules`, `isDetachedHead`, `handleDetachedHead`, `getDefaultBranch`) used by the Git batch scripts (`git-batch-branch.js`, `git-batch-mr.js`, `git-check-updates.js`, `get-all-logs.js`), and `repo-utils.js` (exports `findGitRepositories` with a default skip-set) used by `git-batch-stash.js`. The Git scripts discover repositories by reading `.gitmodules` in the project root and walking submodules; they execute git commands through `child_process.exec/execFile` promisified via `util.promisify`. The SFTP script (`sftp-sync.js`) is standalone, reads connection config from `.vscode/sftp.json`, groups uploads per host/port/user, and shells out to the external `psftp` binary. The encoding converter (`convert-encoding.js`) is also standalone and depends on `iconv-lite` installed locally under `scripts/node_modules`. There is no package exports or bin manifest — scripts are run directly with Node, and the local `package.json` only declares the `iconv-lite` dependency.
